calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT l.store_id, SUM(l.net_amount) lines_net
  FROM lines l WHERE l.store_id<900 AND l.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1
),
rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(CASE WHEN abs(c.lines_net-coalesce(r.rpt_net,0))>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatched,
 sum(c.lines_net) lines_total, sum(r.rpt_net) rpt_total,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.store_id IS NULL THEN c.store_id END) missing_in_rpt
FROM ctl c FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.store_id=c.store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format, count(DISTINCT cs.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ctl AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) lines_net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net, SUM(receipts) rr FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.store_id, c.lines_net, r.rpt_net, c.rc, r.rr FROM rpt r LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(store_id)
WHERE c.store_id IS NULL OR abs(c.lines_net-r.rpt_net)>0.5 OR c.rc<>r.rr
ORDER BY 1
